description: the shot list director (Pipelines board: Script → Director → Qwen Image → Output, chat, fan-out max 24): a director agent on the local 27B reads the script, may search the gallery, read the library and memory, add rows, and answers a list of up to 24 shot prompts; the step fans out over it (one branch per shot, 1 seed each) and binds each branch's item as its prompt. Worst case: 24 runs; the agent 6 turns × 1 visit = 6 LLM calls, 12 tool calls. Nothing leaves the machine; per batch its chat asks at most 100 wakes x 6 turns x 2 = 1200 calls (16000 tokens and 12 tool calls a wake) and agents may add up to 100 rows

director.title: Director
director.instruction: Turn the script into a shot list: one image prompt per shot, using the @elements the script names. Keep shots short and concrete.
